translations.settings.languageHint: Applied immediately on this screen and when navigating to the others. To add languages, drop the .json file in the app i18n folder.
translations.settings.upscaleGpusHint: Empty = automatic: detects the NVIDIA cards, one worker each plus an extra on the primary. To pick manually, comma-separated indices; repeating an index gives that card more workers (0,2,0). The ncnn engine uses VULKAN indices; ONNX uses DXGI/DirectML (lists below). The Hardware (GPU) page, when configured, takes precedence over this field.
translations.settings.outputDirHint: Where converted files will be written. Default: the user's Videos folder.
translations.settings.sourceDirHint: When set, the Episodes screen automatically loads the videos from this folder. You can still choose another folder there.
translations.settings.sourceDirHintEmpty: Not configured — choose the folder manually in the Episodes screen.
translations.settings.upscaleGpusNone: No Vulkan GPU detected (using the primary one).
translations.hardware.title: Hardware (GPU)
translations.hardware.hint: Discrete (PCI) video cards on this computer — CPU/motherboard integrated GPUs are excluded. Workers are parallel jobs on the card: they apply to upscaling AND to AV1 NVENC encoding (episode parts are encoded in parallel, one per worker). Combine freely (2 on the primary only, 2 on both, etc.). Takes effect from the next job in the queue.
translations.hardware.saved: Configuration saved — takes effect from the next job.
translations.encodes.qualityBoost: Max quality (spatial/temporal AQ + UHQ tune + temporal filter — extended analysis, slower encode; prevents macroblocking)
